title: Complementary Boolean output probabilities
statement: Let $m\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $B$ map Boolean words to Boolean values. The probability that $B$ returns false on a uniformly random Boolean word of length $m$ equals one minus the probability that it returns true.
hypotheses_covered: A function from Boolean words to Boolean values
